title: 21-Year-Old Abusive Man Threatens Officers During Arrest
description:
On September 11, 2021, dispatch received a 911 hang up and police were sent to the location in La Crosse, WI. Neighbors in the apartment complex advised dispatch they could hear a child screaming and a man pounding on a door in the hallway. Police entered the residence and asked the male multiple times to step outside to speak but he refused and continued to shout. In other words, we're revisiting our good friend Noah Betz...
